overview.title: Project Overview
overview.description: SplitWallet is a sophisticated expense-sharing application that helps teams track, manage, and reconcile group costs. Users can create wallets, capture expenses, monitor balances, generate reports, and settle debts efficiently.

technical.title: Technical Highlights
technical.item1: Monorepo built with Next.js, tRPC, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and Turborepo.
technical.item2: State sync system with offline operation, background revalidation, and conflict resolution.
technical.item3: AI-powered receipt processing using Gemini 2.5 Pro and PDF export tooling.
technical.item4: Debt minimization algorithms with multiple settlement modes and guardrails.
technical.item5: Comprehensive design system with accessible light/dark modes.

features.title: Key Features
features.item1: Expense management with configurable distribution models per user/group.
features.item2: Wallet hierarchy with permissions, invitations, and contextual insights.
features.item3: Real-time updates, offline support, and transparent sync states.
features.item5: Premium functionality backed by Stripe subscriptions.
